description: All published details of one room type: description, size, guests, all features, facts, photos with alt text, FAQ and the room page URL. Use the room_id from list_rooms. For prices on dates use check_availability.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

room_id.description: Room id from list_rooms, e.g. comfort-double.

name: get_room

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Room details
